newsitem.title: USA: Elcor sees FY 1997 EPS of $1.30-$1.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: Elcor sees FY 1997 EPS of $1.30-$1.50/shr.

text.p: Elcor Corp said its current forecasted earnings per share for the fiscal year 1997 remain in the range of $1.30 to $1.50 per share, up from $1.16 in fiscal 1996.
The company said it expects strong demand for its patented Enhanced High Definition and Raised Profile Prestique shingles will boost shipments and sales to record levels for fiscal 1997.

Elcor said it continues to believe earnings per share during the second and third quarters should be in the general range of, or possibly lower than, the year ago comparable quarters and results will remain pressured until manufacturing output and sales at new plants rise above the break-even point.
It said it expects fourth quarter earnings to benefit from the seasonal increase in demand for products produced by these two new plants.
The company earlier reported higher fiscal 1997 first quarter earnings and revenues.
